# Check input first

`W3` · Coding rule

Validate every input first with Validator::make($request->all(), […]); failure → W2 with $validator->errors()->first(); cast ids/numbers, whitelist enums, clamp limit; request input never reaches limit()/*Raw/DB::raw uncast
